definitions.explanation: The sliding or collapse of a mass of earth or rock down a slope, typically triggered by heavy rain or earthquakes.
An overwhelming victory in an election or competition, by analogy with the unstoppable force of a landslide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{地滑|じすべ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A landslide occurred due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {地滑|じすべ}り⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A landslide warning has been issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{地滑|じすべ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A large-scale landslide occurred in the mountainous area due to the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {地滑|じすべ}り⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧だった。
⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{地滑|じすべ}り⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party won by a landslide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地滑|じすべ}り⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な{大勝|たいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}め→収める：02022_osameru⟧、⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They won a landslide victory in the election, resulting in a change of government.

notes:
Also written as {地|じ}すべり. A common natural disaster in mountainous Japan, where heavy rainfall and earthquakes frequently trigger landslides. The figurative sense {地滑|じすべ}り⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (landslide-like) is frequently used in political and election coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地滑|じすべ}り⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧: landslide advisory
- {地滑|じすべ}り⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦{区域|くいき}→区域：00251_kuiki⟧: landslide danger zone
- {地滑|じすべ}り⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧: landslide victory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧: mudslide; debris slide — often involves mud and debris
- ⟦{崖崩|がけくず}れ→崖崩れ：20245_gakekuzure⟧: cliff collapse — specifically from a cliff face
- {山崩|やまくず}れ: mountainside collapse — larger-scale mountain collapse
